meaning: Full body read is a reading-scope claim, not independent numerical reproduction. Supplements and page coverage are recorded separately. Earlier methods screening is preserved in coverage.json.

papers.title: Optimization of Trading Strategies on Indian Stock Market System using Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) Indicator
papers.authors: Regi Kumar V; Mekha S
papers.locations: Full PDF body; precise scope and supplementary limitations in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.rule: MACD 12/26/9; four signal variants; next-day long-share entries with available cash.
papers.finding: Positive gross results are reported, with Sharpe ratios 0.27–0.35 and substantial drawdowns.
papers.limitations: Transaction costs explicitly omitted. Trade-count inconsistencies between prose and table. No untouched chronological holdout established. No option execution test.
papers.next: Keep one fixed MACD baseline; do not optimize these four variants again to obtain a winner.

papers.title: The effectiveness of technical trading strategies: Evidence from Indian equity markets
papers.authors: Harikrishna Tadas; Jeevan Nagarkar; Sushant Malik; Dharmesh K. Mishra; Dipen Paul
papers.locations: Full PDF body; precise scope and supplementary limitations in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.sample: 14 sector-representative large stocks; hourly bars, January–August 2022
papers.rule: SMA crossover, EMA/RSI, and BB/RSI combinations. BB rule enters above the middle band with RSI above 50; exits on lower-band touch or RSI condition.
papers.finding: BB/RSI positive in 11/14 stocks and ahead of buy-and-hold in 10/14 in the study.
papers.limitations: Short sample; no untouched holdout established; exact RSI/exit parameters and dated cost treatment not sufficiently specified for faithful execution. The 39.54% figure is profitable-trade percentage, not portfolio return.
papers.next: Recover full indicator/exit settings; test cash implementation before any option translation.

papers.title: Investment and Trading Strategies in Indian Stock Market
papers.authors: Shahid Ashraf; Mirza Allim Baig
papers.publication: International Journal of Arts and Commerce 4(3), 1–15
papers.locations: Full PDF body; precise scope and supplementary limitations in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.sample: 92 CNX 100 stocks with complete history, April 2009–March 2014
papers.rule: Investment groups use beta/debt-equity; trading analysis measures recovery from minimum prices over the study window.
papers.finding: Large recoveries after those minima are reported.
papers.limitations: The minimum is selected using the subsequent price path. No observable rule identifies that bottom in advance. Complete-history selection and historical availability of fundamental classifications also need correction.
papers.next: A causal drawdown/reversal strategy would be a new hypothesis, not a reproduction of these returns.

papers.title: Options Trading Strategies for the Indian Market—An effective Financial Derivative Tool
papers.authors: Partha Chatterjee; Juhi Chatterjee; Rumela Baidya; Ankita Das; Jishu Das
papers.locations: Full PDF body; precise scope and supplementary limitations in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.sample: Descriptive secondary-source discussion and payoff examples
papers.rule: Call/put positions, spreads, straddles and butterflies described.
papers.finding: Explains possible payoffs rather than estimating predictive profitability.
papers.limitations: No chronological signal cohort, false-positive denominator or net historical trade ledger.
papers.next: Use only for structure taxonomy; do not interpret maximum payoff as expected profit.

papers.title: A Trading Strategy for the Indian Stock Market: Analysis and Implications
papers.authors: Madhusudan Karmakar; Madhumita Chakraborty
papers.locations: Full PDF body; precise scope and supplementary limitations in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.rule: Trading-day turn-of-month window is last two plus first two trading days; also studies first-half-month effects.
papers.finding: Higher average returns in these calendar windows.
papers.limitations: Historical index association, not a modern funded F&O ledger. Authors explicitly acknowledge costs can remove profitability. Historical market structure differs substantially.
papers.next: Use fixed calendar benchmark with dated sessions; no optimized calendar search.

papers.title: Hedging Demand and Intraday Momentum within the Indian Stock Market
papers.authors: Adarsh Motwani; Sam Burrin; Aanjaneya Sharma
papers.locations: Full PDF body; precise scope and supplementary limitations in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.sample: 44 selected liquid stock futures and NIFTY; minute data, January 2021–July 2024
papers.rule: Previous-close-to-entry return and opening return predict late-session direction; fitted and gamma-conditioned variants.
papers.finding: Positive gross portfolios reported; authors revise close-time trading because implementation erodes returns.
papers.limitations: Costs excluded; timing/lookback/model filters optimized. Displayed NGE formula lacks an explicit negative put-position term although it filters for negative NGE. Sign convention unresolved. OI alone is not signed dealer inventory.
papers.next: Freeze plain direction rules; actual executable pre-close exit; no gamma filter until its definition is resolved.

papers.title: Hedging demand and market intraday momentum
papers.authors: Guido Baltussen; Zhi Da; Sten Lammers; Martin Martens
papers.locations: All 27 PDF pages, appendices A–D, figures and formulas; FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.sample: More than 60 futures across four asset classes, extending 1974–2020
papers.rule: Rest-of-day return from previous close predicts final-half-hour return; equal-weight and forecasting variants.
papers.finding: Broad intraday continuation with subsequent reversal; proposed hedging mechanism.
papers.limitations: Main strategy results exclude costs; one-tick S&P illustration is not Indian retail execution. The signed-put gamma proxy depends on assumptions about end-user positions.
papers.next: Test causal late-session direction, after local costs, without assuming the mechanism establishes cheap option convexity.

papers.title: Intraday time series momentum: Global evidence and links to market characteristics
papers.authors: Z. Li; A. Sakkas; A. Urquhart
papers.publication: Journal of Financial Markets 57, 100619; accepted manuscript titled Intraday Time Series Momentum: International Evidence
papers.locations: All 64 PDF pages, appendices A–C, 15 tables and three figures; FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.rule: Direction of previous-close-to-first-half-hour return selects final-half-hour long/short position; recursive forecast tests start after five years.
papers.finding: International intraday predictability and diversified strategy results.
papers.limitations: India is not in this sample. Index-price returns do not establish net executable futures/ETF/option returns. Full local transaction-cost calibration remains required.
papers.next: Use fixed opening-return sign as a separate comparator to rest-of-day sign.

papers.title: Four Factor Model in Indian Equities Market
papers.authors: Sobhesh Kumar Agarwalla; Joshy Jacob; Jayanth R. Varma
papers.publication: IIMA Working Paper 2013-09-05; original September version
papers.locations: All PDF pages, tables, formulas and figures; detailed scope in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.rule: Monthly winners/losers use preceding 11-month return excluding latest month; 30/70 breakpoints, size intersections and value weights.
papers.finding: Strong historical momentum factor; liquidity filtering and a distressed-delisting adjustment are explicit.
papers.limitations: Factor spread is not a fully funded small-account return. Monthly turnover costs, short borrowing, lot granularity and point-in-time universe require an implementation layer.
papers.next: Specify long-only cash adaptation separately from faithful long-short factor reproduction; obtain years rather than one 90-day window.

papers.title: Post-Earnings-Announcement Drift Anomaly in India: A Test of Market Efficiency
papers.authors: Harshita; Shveta Singh; Surendra S. Yadav
papers.locations: All PDF pages, tables, references; formula/figure inspection detailed in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.rule: Seasonal EPS change scaled by pre-announcement price; earnings-surprise portfolios and excess returns from day +2 to +64.
papers.finding: Significant drift associated with earnings surprise, robust to specified controls and subperiods.
papers.limitations: Quarter-wide ranks must not use later announcements; requires historical releases, restatement control and costs. Selection using subsequent nonzero returns is not an executable eligibility gate. Not a same-day doubling test.
papers.next: Prior-period surprise thresholds and as-released EPS; separate cash holding horizon from short-dated options.

papers.title: Testing the Profitability of Technical Trading Rules across Market Cycles: Evidence from India
papers.authors: S. Muruganandan
papers.locations: All PDF pages, formulas, tables and figures; detailed scope in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.rule: Lagged RSI/MACD decisions, next-session open-to-close return; retrospective market-cycle partitions.
papers.finding: RSI generally poor; some gross MACD sell-signal results, insufficient consistent risk-adjusted performance.
papers.limitations: Published RSI construction uses closing-price levels on up/down days rather than standard gain/loss magnitudes. MACD signal uses SMA and conditions differ from a conventional crossover. Index execution/cost gap remains. Negative results apply to these implementations, not all technical strategies.
papers.next: Preserve formula differences; do not cite as universal rejection of RSI/MACD.

papers.title: Market intraday momentum: APAC evidence
papers.authors: Manapon Limkriangkrai; Daniel Chai; Gaoping Zheng
papers.locations: All PDF pages, tables, references; formula/figure inspection detailed in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.sample: ETFs for China, Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, plus US replication
papers.rule: First and penultimate half-hour returns predict final-half-hour return; historical-mean OOS comparator.
papers.finding: Evidence varies by market; stronger in China/Japan, absent over full sample in Hong Kong/Singapore.
papers.limitations: India excluded. Volume/volatility subsample thresholds calculated across later observations cannot be copied into a causal live selector. Statistical replication is not net small-account profitability.
papers.next: Require Indian validation and lagged thresholds rather than assuming international transfer.

papers.title: The informational role of algorithmic traders in the option market
papers.authors: Rohini Grover
papers.publication: Finance Research Group working paper, May version
papers.locations: All PDF pages, formulas, tables and figures; detailed scope in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.sample: NIFTY option orders/trades, January 2009–August 2013; five-minute analysis
papers.rule: Investor-type and algorithmic flags identify signed net buying pressure; regressions distinguish information and inventory effects.
papers.finding: Directional information attributed to non-algorithmic flow, not algorithmic flow, in this sample.
papers.limitations: Requires exchange-level trader-category flags and initiator information unavailable in ordinary historical broker candles. No net deployable trading ledger. Aggregate OI is not a substitute for participant-level signed flow.
papers.next: Any public-feed proxy is a new hypothesis with separate validation.

papers.title: Test of Momentum Investment Strategy using Constituents of CNX 100 index
papers.authors: Tejas Mankar; supervised by Mayank Joshipura
papers.locations: All 31 PDF pages, including portfolio membership annexures and charts; FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.rule: Past 3/6-month winners versus losers, overlapping 3/6/12-month holdings.
papers.finding: Positive gross momentum evidence reported.
papers.limitations: Zero transaction costs assumed. Explicitly excludes stocks delisted during the testing period, introducing future-dependent selection. Short-side implementation and concurrent portfolio capital need rebuilding.
papers.next: Prefer L09's transparent factor construction as baseline; retain delisted stocks in any new test.

papers.title: Time-Varying Conditional Profitability of Momentum Strategies in Commodity Futures Market: Evidence from India
papers.authors: Ritika Jaiswal; Rashmi Uchil
papers.publication: Asian Journal of Business and Accounting 13(2); 10.22452/ajba.vol13no2.9
papers.locations: All PDF pages, tables, formulas and figures; detailed scope in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.rule: 24 ranking/holding combinations; equal-weight positive-return winners and negative-return losers; alternative roll conventions.
papers.finding: Selected one-month-ranking strategies remain profitable under the authors' turnover-cost assumptions.
papers.limitations: Multiple strategy selection; costs borrowed from other studies rather than dated Indian retail bills; margin and whole contracts absent. Reported monthly/annual figures and table arithmetic require reconstruction before accepting magnitudes.
papers.next: Rebuild contract rolls, return units and capital denominator before parameter comparison; Gold Petal alone is not this portfolio.

papers.title: Animal Spirits on Steroids: Evidence from Retail Options Trading in India
papers.authors: Vikas Agarwal; Pulak Ghosh; Nagpurnanand Prabhala; Haibei Zhao
papers.publication: CFR WP 25-09; downloaded August 31, 2025 version; SSRN lists later revision
papers.locations: Abstract, introduction, data definitions and trading-cost treatment; full tables/revision comparison pending
papers.finding: Reports losses and migration toward cheaper/riskier option contracts after constraints change.
papers.limitations: Population evidence does not disprove every strategy or identify a tradeable counterparty signal. Private trader identifiers cannot be reconstructed from broker bars.
papers.next: Compare latest revision; test strike affordability as an economic constraint, never as a presumed edge.

papers.title: The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
papers.authors: David H. Bailey; Jonathan M. Borwein; Marcos Lopez de Prado; Qiji Jim Zhu
papers.publication: November 2014 working version; later Journal of Computational Finance publication
papers.locations: All PDF pages, tables, references; formula/figure inspection detailed in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.finding: Measures degradation from selecting the best in-sample strategy among alternatives.
papers.limitations: A diagnostic of the declared strategy-selection process, not a probability of live profitability. Reordering blocks does not recreate chronological capital constraints or repair timestamp leakage.
papers.next: Keep all trial histories; chronological deployment test remains separate.

papers.title: The Deflated Sharpe Ratio: Correcting for Selection Bias, Backtest Overfitting and Non-Normality
papers.authors: David H. Bailey; Marcos Lopez de Prado
papers.publication: Journal of Portfolio Management; author manuscript July 31
papers.locations: All PDF pages, tables, references; formula/figure inspection detailed in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
papers.finding: Adjusts performance assessment for selection and non-normal returns.
papers.limitations: Requires meaningful trial count/dependence estimates and sufficient observations. Cannot correct hindsight-selected orders, missing fees or invalid fills.
papers.next: Report search-aware diagnostics with uncertainty; do not invent independence of correlated variants.

papers.title: Foreign Institutional Positions and Short-Horizon Option Payoffs
papers.authors: Prithu Vatsa
papers.finding: Abstract reports conditional payoff association but no improvement in retrospective point-in-time forecast loss.
papers.limitations: Current landing explicitly says download unavailable. Entry/settlement/cost mechanics unverified. Do not infer a profitable FPI-following bot.
papers.next: Find public author version without bypassing access controls; inspect forecast failure first.

papers.title: Risk-adjusted Returns from Statistical Arbitrage Opportunities in Indian Stock Futures Market
papers.authors: Geetu Aggarwal; Navdeep Aggarwal
papers.finding: Rolling distance/cointegration pairs on 2011–2017 daily futures reportedly profitable after costs.
papers.limitations: Full rules, cost schedule, return denominator and margin unverified. Two futures legs cannot be assumed affordable.
papers.next: Acquire public author manuscript; audit roll, synchronization and short-leg fills.

papers.title: Dynamics of variance risk premium: Evidence from India
papers.authors: Ganesh Sankar; Shankar Ramachandran; Jijo Lukose P. J.
papers.finding: Studies pricing of variance risk and its components in India.
papers.limitations: A modeled variance-swap premium is not a funded option-selling return. Full estimation, hedges and costs pending.
papers.next: Inspect original paper and later contrary results before specifying bounded-risk implementation.

papers.title: Tests of Technical Analysis in India
papers.authors: Sanjay Sehgal; Meenakshi Gupta
papers.finding: Abstract finds technical strategies economically weak after costs against passive comparisons.
papers.limitations: Exact samples, signals and fees require body; cannot generalize to all current intraday variants.
papers.next: Find author copy; compare directly with S02's substantially shorter positive sample.

papers.title: Intraday overreaction and underreaction: profitability analysis and factor explanations
papers.authors: Adnan Ahmed Siddiqui; Arun Kumar Misra
papers.finding: Next-day long/short return association based on speed of price adjustment.
papers.limitations: Full construction, costs and feasible shorting unknown; not interchangeable with our previous selloff-call rule.
papers.next: Recover author manuscript and define price-adjustment measure without future-day sorting.

papers.title: Earnings Surprise and Sophisticated Investor Preferences in India
papers.authors: Kaustav Sen
papers.publication: SSRN 1318705; later journal version to reconcile
papers.finding: Reports Indian earnings drift using time-series forecasts, including a transaction-cost claim.
papers.limitations: Need body to verify forecasting timestamps and net costs.
papers.next: Compare with L10; investigate publication and announcement-date handling.

papers.title: Betting Against Beta in the Indian Market
papers.authors: Agarwalla; Jacob; Varma; Vasudevan
papers.finding: Indian low-beta anomaly/BAB factor investigated.
papers.limitations: Beta-scaled long/short portfolios require financing and are not small-bankroll option trades.
papers.next: Read body and distinguish long-only low-volatility investing from levered BAB.
papers.locations: Full PDF body; precise scope and supplementary limitations in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md

papers.title: Information content of order imbalance in an order-driven market: Indian Evidence
papers.finding: Studies short-horizon information from tick transactions/order-book snapshots.
papers.limitations: Minute bars cannot reconstruct order imbalance or queue position. Full predictive versus contemporaneous design pending.
papers.next: Verify signed-flow construction and feed availability before allocating backtest effort.

papers.title: Trading the Volatility Risk Premium on Nifty 50: Strategy Backtest with Realistic Frictions
papers.authors: Sumin Pillai
papers.finding: Four short-volatility strategies over 119 monthly cycles; stated brokerage/slippage/STT model.
papers.limitations: Constant tax assumption over changing regimes needs audit. Margin, hedge rebalancing, whole lots and tail losses unverified.
papers.next: Inspect full body before accepting the description of realistic frictions.
papers.locations: Full PDF body; precise scope and supplementary limitations in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md

papers.title: The Variance Risk Premium in Nifty 50: A Structural Anatomy Across Nine Empirical Filters
papers.authors: Yash Agarwal
papers.finding: Descriptive minute-option implied-versus-realized variance analysis.
papers.limitations: Exploratory decomposition, not executable trading evidence.
papers.next: Check matched maturity, forward realized-variance labels and IV cleaning.
papers.locations: Full PDF body; precise scope and supplementary limitations in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md

papers.title: Market intraday momentum
papers.authors: Lei Gao; Yufeng Han; Sophia Zhengzi Li; Guofu Zhou
papers.finding: US first-half-hour return predicts last-half-hour return; foundational study for L06–L08/L12.
papers.limitations: India transfer and current retail costs unestablished; reconcile working-paper and journal versions.
papers.next: Author manuscript and original execution-cost assumptions.
papers.locations: Full PDF body; precise scope and supplementary limitations in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md

papers.title: Momentum anomaly: evidence from India
papers.authors: Valeed Ansari; Soha Khan
papers.finding: Reports momentum during 1995–2006 and examines risk/behavioral explanations.
papers.limitations: Full point-in-time universe, costs and financing not yet reviewed.
papers.next: Trace full author text and later Indian replications.
papers.locations: Full PDF body; precise scope and supplementary limitations in FULLTEXT_NOTES.md
